link.note: Cozes Reformed baptism of André (1663) per Garner; identification with the Meschers pilot rests on name, date and parish.

bio: Daniel Lamoureux, son of Jean Lamoureux, stood godparent at Cozes in 1656 with Marie Touchay; their son André was born 3 Nov 1663.
sources: Kenn True Garner, The French Reformed Church, Cozes, Saintonge: Baptisms 1655-1668 (FamilySearch Books); FHL film 1868505 item 5 pp.1, 48
